answer: Trust propagation with early termination: seed 20 audited identities with trust, then spread it along attestation edges for log2(N) rounds, splitting each node's trust evenly among its neighbors. Fake clusters connect to the honest graph through few attack edges, so trust barely leaks into them, and rewards scale with degree-normalized trust. Adding 100 fakes adds almost no trust unless each buys new real links, a costly climb up a terrace. Anyone recomputes scores from public edges, like checking cargo at a wharf. Pigment-bright fake accounts stay pale.
